items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: So, it ended up then that we made an arrangement for Georgia Brown. Everything was beautiful. She could sing man, she could sing. She had a beautiful voice.

ctx.x: We at intermission right now. So, there was a whole lot of crying going on. I said, 'Darlin' why do you want to mess with these people. You in Canada. She says, I can't understand why they always ducking me -- I says you going to have to duck, they'll make you duck.
So, it ended up then that we made an arrangement for Georgia Brown. Everything was beautiful. She could sing man, she could sing. She had a beautiful voice.
So, everything is going on beautiful, beautiful, beautiful, then they start with going to the army and most of them was in the tank corps.
